notes.title: Toree Saturn will be $5
notes.notes:
Toree Saturn will cost $5

Felt like it was a good time to announce that right now :)

With recent news about games getting more expensive, I felt it was about time I let you all know that the game will be $5. It's basically going to my most expensive game yet, though this has nothing to do with any tariffs, or things getting more expensive or anything! 

My last game, Super Kiwi 64 was $3 because the budget for it got a bit bigger and I had more professional help involved, making the price a bit higher than usual. The same applies here, only that it's even more professional help this time and some of it is really, really cool stuff. Personal bucket list stuff basically!

It is a bit unfortunate that I will release my most expensive game during a time like this and I am really sorry for that. Rest assured, after this project I will go back to some easier and quicker to produce games again. The first project after Toree Saturn will be a classic $1 Siactro game for sure! :) 

All I can say is, that I feel the higher budget for this game was really worth it (and very likely a one time thing, but we will see about that later) and I hope you all will enjoy this game one way or another. 

As for an update on a release date: I am not fully there yet but I feel like I can announce something about that soon!

notes.title: Toree Saturn delayed to early 2025!
notes.notes:
Been a while and I am not bringing the best of news sadly: 

I have to delay Toree Saturn into early 2025. :(

A december release was possible, but the quality would have suffered a lot. I worked with really incredible people on this and I am not going to treat their work with a low quality release. 

I am very sorry, but it will be worth it, I promise!🙇‍♂️

Also: new trailer is on the way! :)
